basic_info.description: Located in Vibrant Noe Valley near Valencia Corridor, This Updated and Well Cared for 5-Unit Building Offers a solid investment opportunity, with lots of upside! The current projected Income & Expense profile offer 6.43% cap & 11.3 GRM. 4 x 1 BR/1BA Units Including 1 Newly Remodeled, with custom cabinets, hi end appliances, and in-unit laundry are rented with Solid Tenants, and 1 Vacant Full Flat 3BR/2BA, completely Remodeled unit with Custom Cabinets, Stone kitchen Island, Hi End appliances, In-Unit Steam Clean Washer & Steam Dryer, 2-Zone Central Heating System & fire Alarm, Refinished Wood Floors. Building Features Many major rehabs & upgrades, including Soft Story Retrofit, 2024 New Roof, Double Paned Windows, New Exterior Paint, All Units New Hi Efficiency Water Heaters & Lo Flush Toilets. One Bedroom units feature various updates: some appliances, bathroom Rehab/updates. New LED Lighting fixtures in common areas. Updated Rear Decks & Stairs. Lower-level features tradesman entrance, separate utility / storage / workshop room, separate electric meters & panels, laundry room with washer & dryer, 2 large rentable storage units, and cozy backyard with fruit Trees & sitting area and access to rear stairs. Walking distance to many amenities, shops, restaurants, & transportation.
